scope: Manually labeled local diagnostic examples, including five bundled provider fixture titles. Synthetic task text, aliases, ambiguous names, incidental mentions and alternate formulations. No independently labeled scraped corpus exists locally. This is a regression/coverage audit, not a representative accuracy estimate; labels describe expected retrieval hints, not the only possible solution algorithm. Four DP subtypes and two untagged formulations explicitly probe coverage gaps.
